name: Insecurities
overview: Scripture reveals that insecurities stem from a failure to embrace the truth of our God-given identity and the abundant life Christ offers. We are fearfully and wonderfully made, a truth that should inspire confidence rather than self-condemnation, as judging others only condemns ourselves. Knowing the truth of Christ sets us free from the thief who seeks to steal, kill, and destroy, enabling us to live with hope, patience in trials, and steadfast prayer. Honesty and putting off the old self are essential to overcoming insecurities and walking in the new life God provides.
